decisions.evidence: Putting the six neighbors together, the three positive neighbors all share a common theme of lipophilic, rigid, ketone-containing scaffolds with only modest countervailing features, while the three negative neighbors emphasize properties such as higher aliphatic heterocycle count, stronger acidity-related features, and less favorable lipophilicity/flexibility balance. The positive neighbors dominate the local analog space, and the overall balance supports option (B): inhibits SARS-CoV-2 replication.
